A '''''Munificent''-class star frigate''' served as the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] of [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TF-1726/Legends|TF-1726]] at the [[Sky Battle of Quell]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] deployed hundreds of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] against the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']] to ensure its destruction.
